title: Whipstick Farm
specs: Over 30 years of experience in training horses and riders
Customized programs for all levels in hunter, jumper and equitation rings
Produced riders who have won championships at major finals across the country
blurb: Whipstick Farm provides customized training programs for riders and horses of all levels. They have over 30 years of experience and have produced riders who have won championships at major finals across the country. The team includes Frank, Bonnie, and Ailish Cunniffe, who continue to train students and horses to achieve top honors in the sport.
